E0063

Teaching: applied rules use `#`, not the compile-time/fact-read prefix `@`

What

Teaching: applied rules use `#`, not the compile-time/fact-read prefix `@`

Why

`#` marks attributes, instructions and properties; prefix `@` marks compile-time names and fact reads

Fix

Use `#` for an applied rule and reserve `@` for compile-time or fact reads.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0063: tests/ui/e0063_at_applied_rule.stderr.

Error [jet.CompileTimePrefixOnRule]: Applied rules use `#`, not `@`
  --> tests/ui/e0063_at_applied_rule.jet:2:1
    |
  2 | @ Test
    | ^
 Why: `#` marks attributes, instructions, and properties; prefix `@` marks compile-time names and fact reads, while infix `@` stays a package-source separator
 Fix: Replace the leading `@` with `#`
